This local accepted change is not a rule to remove input validation.",
        "The new task drags a valid pill between two windows onto collapsed Cc, directly checking initial button/row state, the opened target row, address/count and source emptiness. Its disconnected-source flag is explicit because the removed pill cannot receive dragend. Every new assertion has a nonempty expected-result message with should. It does not directly test Bcc, malformed payloads, keyboard operation or focus. No test or native drag ran.",
